notes:
TIER 1 (curl + WebFetch) blocked by Cloudflare managed challenge on robots.txt and category pages (403 / 'Just a moment...' JS challenge). Escalated to TIER 3 (Claude-in-Chrome; no separate Playwright/CDP tool was available in this environment, so tier 2 was skipped straight to the browser). robots.txt (fetched via Chrome after the challenge cleared) has an explicit User-agent block listing ClaudeBot, Claude-User and Claude-SearchBot with the SAME rules as the general Allow-heavy block (only technical/AJAX/filter paths disallowed; all category/product pages allowed) -> proceeded. Site also publishes /llms.txt (top-2000-SKU index only, no seasonal taxonomy) which was checked but not authoritative for full counts.

DISCOVERY METHOD: used the site's own on-site search (both the UI search box and its keyword.php?keyword= endpoint) to test every target holiday, then walked the resulting Christmas hub page's own sub-navigation to enumerate every Christmas sub-category and open each one directly to read its own displayed PLP result count (priority-1 qty method). 

CHRISTMAS (found, genuine site taxonomy, hub page https://www.templeandwebster.com.au/Christmas-C1954055.html, 451 results at the hub level): hub sub-nav lists 9 links as siblings. Verified each by opening its own PLP: Christmas Trees=91 (Christmas-Trees-C1809102.html), Christmas Decorations=204 (Christmas-Decorations-C1954273.html), Wreaths & Garlands=39 (Wreaths-and-Garlands-C1955334.html - also appears as an internal 'Wreaths & Garlands (39)' type-facet inside Christmas Decorations, i.e. genuine overlap between two legitimate sibling Christmas PLPs, not a duplicate listing, so both kept per the overlap rule), Christmas Dinnerware=80 (Christmas-Dinnerware-C1961382.html), Tree Skirts=7 (Tree-Skirts-C1960980.html), Christmas Lights=158 (Christmas-Lights-C1956781.html; note the hub page's own left-facet aggregation showed a stale/different 202, but the direct PLP's own displayed total of 158 was used per qty-method priority). EXCLUDED from rows: Christmas Fragrance (nav link Christmas-Fragrances-C1956581.html currently has 0 products and 302-redirects straight back to the Christmas hub - not a live PLP right now); Gift Shop (Gift-Shop-C1954762.html is a generic sitewide gift category - Gifts for Her/Him/Kids/Pets, by interest, by price - with zero Christmas-specific framing, just cross-linked from the Christmas nav); Sale Christmas (Sale-Christmas-C1954546.html redirects to the generic sitewide Sale-C1809743.html page - a filtered subset/duplicate of the Christmas hub's own Sale-Only facet, not a distinct category, and also matches the storewide-sale exclusion rule); Gift Card (a single purchasable e-gift-card product, not a product-listing category). 451 (hub) vs 91+204+158=453 (sum of the three main type facets) is consistent with normal cross-category product overlap.

OTHER HOLIDAYS CHECKED (all absent) - each tested via the site's own search (UI box and /keyword.php?keyword=): Halloween -> 1 loosely-matched, unrelated product ('Winsor Adjustable Over The Table Garden Arch') via search fallback, no Halloween nav/category anywhere; Diwali -> 'Sorry, we couldn't find anything matching diwali' (0 results); Thanksgiving -> 'Sorry, we couldn't find anything matching thanksgiving' (0 results); Valentine's Day ('valentine') -> 10 unrelated results (did-you-mean 'valentina', generic furniture/vanities), no category; New Year ('new year') -> 2511 generic keyword-matched results across Decor/Rugs/Sale (plain keyword dump, no dedicated New Year category or PLP, no redirect to a clean category URL the way Christmas/Easter got). Easter: search redirected to https://www.templeandwebster.com.au/Easter-Entertaining-C1954771.html (171 results) but this is a storewide seasonal SALE/marketing landing page, not a genuine Easter product category - the listed facets are ordinary furniture/homewares categories (Bar Stools, Dining Tables, Rugs, Console Tables, Wall Art, Outdoor Chairs, etc.) and the actual products shown are generic sale items (outdoor dining sets, storage ottomans, floor lamps) with no Easter-specific theming beyond marketing copy; excluded per the storewide-sale/marketing-landing-page rule. No dedicated Easter Decorations/Easter Eggs/Easter Table PLP was found anywhere in nav or search.

Also checked: top nav mega-menus for Furniture/Outdoor/Lighting/Bed & Bath/Rugs/Décor/Wall Art/Office/Baby & Kids/Renovation/Kitchenware/Pets/Fitness/Sale & Clearance - none expose Halloween, Diwali, Valentine's, Thanksgiving or New Year sub-items; the Décor mega-menu flyout (Mirrors, Plant Pots & Stands, Decorative Accents, Soft Furnishings, Candles & Diffusers, Clocks, Artificial Plants & Flowers) contains no seasonal/holiday entries - Christmas is a standalone hub reachable via search/direct URL rather than the main mega-menu.
